tasks.short: Inspect and maintain workshop equipment, repair tools, keep the maintenance schedule, get quotes for new equipment, choose what to buy, request the purchase and record new equipment.

steps.what: Vocational teacher inspects and maintains laboratory equipment and tools
Vocational teacher repairs tools or arranges repair with the workshop technician
Vocational teacher keeps the maintenance schedule in a spreadsheet
Vocational teacher asks suppliers for quotes for new equipment by e-mail
Vocational teacher chooses which equipment to acquire
Vocational teacher e-mails the purchase request to the budget holder
Vocational teacher records new equipment in the inventory list

tasks.design: Workshop equipment goes into the school's maintenance system ({OPS_SYSTEM}) with recurring tasks and reminders, replacing the spreadsheet schedule and inventory list. New equipment is chosen from the school's purchasing catalogue with framework suppliers ({PROCUREMENT}), so fewer quotes are needed; once the teacher has chosen, the request goes to the budget holder in the same system and the item is added to the inventory on delivery. Maintaining and repairing stay with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Schedules and inventories were kept in spreadsheets and quotes gathered by e-mail.
tasks.enabler_now: School maintenance and purchasing systems hold recurring tasks and supplier catalogues.
tasks.still_hard: Specialist workshop machines often come from suppliers outside the catalogue.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing which old lathe is worth repairing one more time.

reach.learn: Whether reminders cut breakdowns during lessons.

evidence.claim: Maintenance systems hold recurring tasks with reminders; purchasing systems offer supplier catalogues and request routing.

assumptions: Boundary: from maintenance due and equipment needs to the inventory entry; ordering from the supplier is outside.
Input contract: catalogue kept by the school's purchasing team; fallback is spreadsheets and e-mail quotes.
Maintaining, repairing and choosing do not change.
The budget holder's time is outside the teacher's savings.

incremental.description: Vocational teacher moves the spreadsheet schedule into the maintenance system.

approvals.approved_version: The purchase choice as made by the teacher in s5.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: mostly specialist machines bought outside the catalogue; high: mostly standard tools from framework suppliers.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read the qualification file and exam plan, establish course goals with the team, write the course outline, build the training schedule, check both, and publish them to students.

steps.what: Vocational teacher reads the qualification file and the exam plan
Vocational teacher establishes course goals with the teaching team
Vocational teacher prepares the outline of the instructional program

loop.input: The course goals, the qualification's work processes and last year's outline.
loop.output: A draft course outline with weekly topics, linked to goals.
loop.check: Code checks every goal links to a work process code in the qualification file and every work process in scope is covered; the teacher edits and approves the outline.
loop.stop: Stops when the checks pass and the teacher approves, or after two failed redrafts the teacher writes the outline.
loop.why_not_simpler: Weekly topics must be written for each course; a template only gives the headings.

steps.what: Vocational teacher builds the training schedule in a spreadsheet
Vocational teacher checks the outline and schedule together
Vocational teacher publishes the outline and schedule to students

tasks.design: A bounded step drafts the course outline from the team's goals, the qualification's work processes and last year's outline; code checks every goal links to a work process and every work process in scope is covered, and the teacher edits the draft. The training schedule is laid out by code over the school's teaching weeks, holidays and internship periods. Once the teacher has checked both, they are published in the learning environment ({LMS}). Setting course goals with the team stays with the teachers.
tasks.previous_blocker: Outlines were rewritten each year and schedules built by hand around the school calendar.
tasks.enabler_now: Language models draft outlines from goals; code lays out schedules over a calendar.
tasks.still_hard: Good outlines reflect what worked in last year's classroom, which no file holds.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing the order of topics so students succeed early.
tasks.altitude: The teacher edits drafts and checks coverage instead of writing from scratch.

evidence.claim: EduGenAI is a chat platform for Dutch education in pilot at Utrecht University, which forbids automated grading on it.
Drafting course outlines falls outside the Annex III education uses, which cover admission, evaluating learning outcomes and detecting cheating.

assumptions: Boundary: from the qualification file to the published course plan; lesson materials are outside.
Input contract: qualification file from the national body; school calendar from the timetabling office; fallback is writing by hand.
Setting goals with the team does not change.
No student data go into the drafting step.
research_questions: How much of the drafted outline survives the teacher's edit?

already_counted.description: Vocational teacher edits and approves the drafted outline.

incremental.description: Vocational teacher keeps the school calendar data current for scheduling.

approvals.approved_version: The outline and schedule as checked by the teacher in s5.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: new courses with no earlier outline; high: yearly updates of existing courses.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read the student's results and progress, advise on course selection and career decisions, look up options and internships, write the talk report, and refer other concerns to the student counsellor.

steps.what: Vocational teacher reads the student's results, attendance and credits before the talk
Vocational teacher advises students on course selection, career decisions and vocational concerns
Vocational teacher looks up course options, internships and follow-on programmes
Vocational teacher writes the talk report in the student file
Vocational teacher refers students with other concerns to the student counsellor

tasks.design: The student administration system ({OTHER}) shows results, attendance and credits on one screen before the talk. Course options, internships and follow-on programmes are searchable in the school's catalogue and internship database, quoting the official entries. The talk report uses a short template with agreed actions. Advising students and referring them to the counsellor stay with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Results, options and internships were gathered from several places before each talk.
tasks.enabler_now: Student systems show progress dashboards; catalogues and internship databases are searchable.
tasks.still_hard: Career choices depend on what the student does not say in a short talk.
tasks.human_edge: Helping a student see a trade they had not thought of.

evidence.claim: Student administration systems can show results, attendance and credits in one view.
Talk reports in the student file are personal data under the GDPR.

assumptions: Boundary: from the student file to the referral; counselling itself is outside.
Input contract: results from student administration; catalogue and internship database kept by the school; fallback is searching several sites.
Advising and referring do not change.
research_questions: Do students switch courses less often after advice?

incremental.description: Vocational teacher reports outdated internship entries.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few advice talks a term; high: a mentor role with many talks.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Choose conferences and training, register for them, attend, read sector updates, integrate relevant information into training programmes, and share what was learned with the team.

steps.what: Vocational teacher chooses conferences, seminars and training sessions to attend
Vocational teacher registers for the chosen events online
Vocational teacher participates in conferences, seminars and training sessions
Vocational teacher reads trade journals and sector updates to keep abreast of developments
Vocational teacher integrates relevant information into training programs
Vocational teacher shares what was learned with the teaching team

tasks.design: Sector news, changes to the qualification file and trade journal alerts are collected in one feed the teaching team follows, so each teacher does not scan the same sources. Updates to the programme go into the shared course library in the document space ({DOCS}), so one teacher's change reaches the whole team. Choosing, registering for and attending events and sharing with the team stay with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each teacher scanned sources alone and updated only their own materials.
tasks.enabler_now: Feeds can gather sector news and qualification changes; shared libraries spread updates.
tasks.still_hard: Turning a conference talk into a lesson takes thought no feed provides.
tasks.human_edge: Bringing an employer's new technique into the workshop.

reach.learn: Whether shared updates reach other courses.

evidence.claim: News feeds can gather sector news and alerts from several sources in one place.

assumptions: Boundary: from event offers and sector news to the team informed; the school's training budget is outside.
Input contract: feed sources chosen by the teaching team; fallback is each teacher's own reading.
Attending events and sharing do not change.
Registration fees are approved as today.
research_questions: Do programme updates reach all teachers of a course?

incremental.description: Vocational teacher prunes feed sources with the team.

approvals.approved_version: The events as chosen by the teacher in s1.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: one conference a year and little reading; high: a fast-changing trade with much sector news.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The vocational teacher keeps maintaining equipment, setting goals, advising students and learning from the field; spreadsheets, blank-page outlines, hand-built schedules and scattered searches shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who spends saved time with employers and students.
